l-e-e4-b06-03.title: Liafuan pergunta sempre tuir ho do ka be?
l-e-e4-b06-03.goal: Verifika se alegasaun katak forma do ida ka verbu be sempre tuir liafuan pergunta loos nafatin, no esplika ho buka kazu ida ne'ebé la loos (kontraezemplu).
l-e-e4-b06-03.material: Alegasaun: Depois de liafuan pergunta hanesan What, Who ka Why, sempre iha do, does, did ka verbu be (is, are). Buka pergunta ne'ebé kontra alegasaun ne'e.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.r.a: Does mai depois de What. Nia tuir alegasaun.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.r.b: Are mai depois de How. Nia tuir alegasaun.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.r.c: Is mai depois de Why. Nia tuir alegasaun.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s1.explain: Iha Who opens the door?, Who mak sujeitu ne'ebé loke odamatan. Iha kazu ida-ne'e, verbu opens mai kedas depois, sein do.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s2.model.0: Iha Who opens the door?, verbu opens mai depois de Who, la'ós do ka be, nune'e alegasaun ne'e sala.
l-e-e4-b06-03.s.s2.model.1: Bainhira Who mak sujeitu, verbu mai kedas depois nia sein do, nune'e deklarasaun katak do ka be sempre mai mak sala.

l-e-e4-b06-08.goal: Deside kritériu (informasaun) ne'ebé ita presiza loos atu prenxe liafuan dahuluk iha ___ bag is this?, no esplika tanbasá ita hili ida-ne'e.
l-e-e4-b06-08.material: ___ bag is this? Resposta mak "It is mine." Ita hakarak hili Whose, Who ka What ba espasu mamuk.
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s1.o.b: Katak resposta mine hatete sé nia nian
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s1.o.c: Katak ida-ne'e hatudu buat ida ne'ebé besik
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s1.r.d: Númeru la determina Whose ka Who.
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s1.explain: Mine signifika "belonging to me." Liafuan ne'ebé husu sé mak nain ba buat ida mak Whose, nune'e sai Whose bag is this?
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s2.model.0: Resposta mine hatete sé mak nain, nune'e ita bele hili Whose, ne'ebé husu kona-ba nain buat ida nian. Ida-ne'e signifika katak resposta mak presiza loos.
l-e-e4-b06-08.s.s2.model.1: Liafuan pergunta depende ba saida mak resposta hatete, nune'e haree sé mak nain.

l-e-e4-b06-09.thinking.2: Hatudu regra ne'ebé sufisiente no la sufisiente

l-e-e4-b06-09.title: Halibur liafuan sira ne'ebé hatudu ordenu
l-e-e4-b06-09.goal: Deside kritériu (informasaun) ne'ebé ita presiza loos atu hili liafuan sira ne'ebé hatudu ordenu, no esplika tanbasá ita hili ida-ne'e.
l-e-e4-b06-09.material: Husi liafuan neen First, Because, Then, So, Next no Finally, ita hakarak halibur de'it liafuan sira ne'ebé hatudu ordenu akontesimentu.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.prompt: Grupu ida-ne'ebé iha de'it liafuan sira ne'ebé hatudu ordenu?
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.r.a: Because hatudu razaun. La kona-ba ordenu.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.r.c: So hatudu rezultadu. La kona-ba ordenu.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.r.d: Because no So hatudu razaun no rezultadu, la'ós ordenu.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s1.explain: First, Then, Next no Finally hatudu ordenu. Because hatudu razaun, no So hatudu rezultadu.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s2.model.0: First, Then, Next no Finally hotu-hotu hatudu buat ne'ebé akontese uluk no ikus, nune'e sira mak liafuan ordenu.
l-e-e4-b06-09.s.s2.model.1: Because hatudu razaun no So hatudu rezultadu, nune'e sira la'ós liafuan ordenu.

l-e-e4-b02-14.goal: Buka regra husi ezemplu balu kona-ba oinsá liafuan sira molok no hafoin but iha relasaun, hatete regra ne'e, no testa ho kazu foun ida.

l-e-e4-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: Hafoin but mai buat ida ne'ebé kontráriu ho parte dahuluk, nune'e "I want to play" mak loos.

l-e-e4-b03-12.topic: Durasaun husi from A to B
l-e-e4-b03-12.goal: Husi ezemplu oioin kona-ba durasaun ne'ebé temi hanesan from 1 to 3, buka no hatete regra, no koko regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.
l-e-e4-b03-12.material: Filme ne'e from 1 to 3 (oras 2). Aula ne'e from 2 to 5 (oras 3). Jogu ne'e from 4 to 5 (oras 1). Uza regra atu buka oras hira mak from 6 to 9.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: 6 mak oras hahú de'it. Ita tenke hasai oras hahú husi oras remata.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Ne'e mak rezultadu husi aumenta 6 no 9. Iha ezemplu sira ne'e, hasai númeru sira malu.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Hasai oras hahú husi oras remata. 9 − 6 = 3, nune'e oras 3 mak durasaun.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Iha ezemplu sira ne'e, hasai oras hahú husi oras remata, hanesan 3 − 1 = 2 no 5 − 2 = 3, nune'e 9 − 6 = oras 3.
l-e-e4-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Oras remata − oras hahú mak tempu ne'ebé uza, nune'e from 6 to 9 mak oras 3.

l-e-e4-b06-25.s.s1.r.b: Iha fraze ho verbu ordináriu ida, fraze ne'e hahú ho Did, tanba ne'e loos.
